status: validated (機械検証合格 2026-11-05; パイロット承認済みの方針で作成)

segments.t: Jude,
a servant of Jesus Christ,
and brother of James,
to those who are called,
segments.note: 「to those who are called」τοῖς κλητοῖς。与格のほぐし

segments.t: sanctified by God the Father,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文の ἡγιασμένοις（聖別された）読みに従い「sanctified」と訳す。ギリシャ語本文は ἠγαπημένοις（愛された）

segments.t: and kept for Jesus Christ:
May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え： ἔλεος ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ ἀγάπη πληθυνθείη

segments.t: Beloved,
while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation,
segments.note: 「while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation」πᾶσαν σπουδὴν ποιούμενος γράφειν ὑμῖν περὶ τῆς κοινῆς ἡμῶν σωτηρίας のほぐし

segments.t: I was constrained to write to you
exhorting you
segments.note: 「you」は ὑμῖν（15番）を受ける英語の補い

segments.t: to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
segments.note: 「earnestly」は ἐπ-（ἐπαγωνίζεσθαι）のほぐし

segments.t: For there are certain men who crept in secretly,
segments.note: 「there are」は英語の補い

segments.t: even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation:
ungodly men,
segments.note: 「men」は ἄνθρωποι（4番）を受ける

segments.t: turning the grace of our God into indecency,
and denying
our only Master,
God,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「God」（θεόν）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: and Lord, Jesus Christ.
Now I desire to remind you,
though you already know this,
segments.note: 「though you already know this」εἰδότας ὑμᾶς ἅπαξ πάντα（一度すべてのことを知っている）を WEB がほぐした表現

segments.t: that the Lord,
segments.note: WEB は Ἰησοῦς を「the Lord」と訳す

segments.t: having saved a people out of the land of Egypt,
afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.
Angels who didn’t keep their first domain,
segments.note: τε（2番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: but deserted their own dwelling place,
he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
segments.note: 「he」は主語の補い（主は5節から続く）

segments.t: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them,
having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh,
segments.note: 「themselves」は英語の補い

segments.t: are shown as an example,
suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming
defile the flesh,
despise authority,
and slander celestial beings.
segments.note: 「celestial beings」は δόξας（栄光ある者たち）の解釈的表現

segments.t: But Michael, the archangel,
when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses,
dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation,
segments.note: 「against him」は διάβολος を受ける英語の補い

segments.t: but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know.
They are destroyed in these things
that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
Woe to them!
For they went in the way of Cain,
and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire,
segments.note: 「ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire」καὶ τῇ πλάνῃ τοῦ Βαλαὰμ μισθοῦ ἐξεχύθησαν

segments.t: and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you,
shepherds who without fear feed themselves;
clouds without water, carried along by winds;
autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
segments.note: 「by the roots」は ἐκ-（ἐκριζωθέντα）のほぐし

segments.t: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame;
wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied,
saying,
“Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
to execute judgment on all,
and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way,
and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
These are murmurers and complainers,
walking after their lusts—and
their mouth speaks proud things—showing
respect of persons to gain advantage.
But you, beloved,
remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
They said to you,
“In the last time there will be mockers,
walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
segments.note: 「ungodly lusts」は τῶν ἀσεβειῶν（不敬虔の欲）の形容詞化

segments.t: These are those who cause divisions
and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
segments.note: 「and are」は英語の補い

segments.t: But you, beloved,
keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith,
segments.note: 「keep」は英語の補い（主動詞 τηρήσατε は21節）

segments.t: praying in the Holy Spirit.
Keep yourselves in God’s love,
looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
On some have compassion, making a distinction,
segments.note: διακρινομένους（疑う者たち）を WEB は「making a distinction」と訳す

segments.t: and some save, snatching them out of the fire
segments.note: 「them」は οὓς を受ける

segments.t: with fear,
segments.note: 「with fear」は οὓς δὲ ἐλεᾶτε ἐν φόβῳ（恐れをもって憐れめ）の句を WEB が前句に寄せたもの

segments.t: hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
Now to him who is able
to keep them from stumbling,
segments.note: 「them」は ὑμᾶς の訳し分け（次項の「you」と同一の語）

segments.t: and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
segments.note: 「you」は ὑμᾶς（5番）の訳し分けで、トークンは前項に付けた

segments.t: to God our Savior,
who alone is wise,
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「wise」（σοφῷ）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない。「alone」は μόνῳ

segments.t: be glory and majesty, dominion and power,
segments.note: ギリシャ語の「διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν」（5–10番）は WEB の本文に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: both now and forever.
segments.note: ギリシャ語の πρὸ παντὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος（全時代の前にも）は WEB では「both now and forever」に圧縮されている

segments.t: Amen.
